title: Calamity Hydra
subtitle: God of Fury. Hydra's Dungeon. 30,000 hp

lines: One head, then three, then five. It grows each phase.
In the last phase its life splits among five heads. Break them one by one.
HYDRA BREATH: a blast per living head.
HELLQUAKE: it leaps, lands in lightning, and shockwaves roll outward.
!Its rage feeds Atomic Breath, Meteor Shower and Calamity.
